evals.prompt: I have a pie chart and need to put it on a PowerPoint slide for a conference room projector. Which format and size?
evals.expected_output: Recommends PNG (or SVG), a pixel width like 1920 or 2x, labels at 14pt+, and PowerPoint insert steps.
assertions: Recommends one format with a reason
States a pixel size or a 2x rule
Mentions a minimum label size of at least 14 pt

evals.prompt: My chart looks blurry when I stretch it in Google Slides.
evals.expected_output: Says PNG was exported too small; export at 2x or use SVG; do not stretch; gives steps.
assertions: Diagnoses low pixel size as the cause
Suggests exporting larger or as SVG
Tells the user not to stretch the image
